verdict.rationale: Fastmail has automations in the form of Filters & Rules (Sieve filters), so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows no version history, change review, or rollback for those rules: the Filters & Rules doc appears only as a title, and community posts mention filters without describing versioning. Undo send is a different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
